errors.layout: This import type does not exist.
errors.unreadable: The file cannot be read: save it again and retry.
errors.too_many: The file has more than {{max}} rows: split it into several files.
errors.empty: The file has no rows to import.
errors.duplicate_column: The column «{{column}}» is matched to more than one header: pick only one.
errors.no_columns: No header is matched to a column.
errors.missing_column: The required column «{{column}}» is missing: add it to the file or match it to a header.
errors.has_errors: {{count}} rows have errors: fix the file and upload it again.
errors.busy: The import is running: retry in a few seconds.
errors.status: This import cannot be done in its current state.
errors.row_failed: The row could not be written: nothing was changed.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to run this import.
